projectDescription: LMSA is a premium Android app that connects to local AI servers (LM Studio, Ollama) or cloud models (OpenRouter) to provide a private, feature-rich chat interface for large language models.
keyFeatures: Connect to LM Studio, Ollama, OpenRouter, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint
Privacy-first: conversations stay on device and local network
Persona & Character Card V2 support with AI-powered generation
Real-time web search via Brave Search API
Multimodal file and image uploads with OCR
Model Context Protocol (MCP) support for LM Studio
Advanced reasoning controls (Thinking Mode, Reasoning Level)
Smart Reply suggestions and Auto-Title generation
Connection presets for quick server switching
LaTeX math rendering and syntax-highlighted code blocks
Export/import chat history and character data
One-time purchase to remove ads — no subscriptions
publicApiSurface: Local server connection (IP + Port for LM Studio/Ollama)
LM Studio API token (for authenticated servers)
Brave Search API key (for web search feature)
Model parameters: temperature, top-p, repetition penalty, max tokens
Reasoning level control: default, low, medium, high, disabled
